_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: Weibull shape 1.5, scale 5, time ratio exp(0.4)

agreement.claim: both engines report the same log time ratio, standard error, interval, shape and log hazard ratio
agreement._note: The library's standard 1e-4, not the 1e-6 used for closed-form entries. lifelines' WeibullAFTFitter stops about 5e-6 short of the maximum on this fixture (log hazard ratio 7.1e-6 apart; its log-likelihood 1.9e-9 below R's), and fit_options={'gtol': ...} did not change it. survreg is at the maximum: harness/survival_examples.test.py's independent optimisation agrees with it to 3e-8.

recovery.claim: the log time ratio, shape and log hazard ratio are close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: Measured by harness/survival_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99 of this generator.
